estate_gate_notice.title: Gate notice
estate_gate_notice.speaker: protagonist
estate_gate_notice.text: A printed notice taped to the gatepost: PLAYGROUND OPEN. Below it, in handwriting: use the side if locked. The tape has been replaced twice.
estate_gate_notice.repeat_text: PLAYGROUND OPEN. Use the side if locked.

record.text: A notice on the estate gate says the playground is open.

estate_wall.title: Estate wall
estate_wall.speaker: protagonist
estate_wall.text: Render patched with a different mix, the new part lighter and already going the same colour as the old. Someone cares enough to patch it twice.
estate_wall.repeat_text: The patched part, going the same colour as the rest.

record.text: The estate wall has been patched twice with different render.
